programme.title: Die PS Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott
programme.desc: Die PS Profis - Mehr Power aus dem Pott - (E04, Lehrprogramm, Deutschland, 2013) Jean Pierre und Sidney machen ab sofort wieder gute Laune beim Autocheck: Auch in der neuen Staffel von Die PS PROFIS - mehr Power aus dem Pott erhält das Ruhrpott-Duo in jeder Sendung den Auftrag von SPORT1-Zuschauern, einen passenden Gebrauchten zu finden. Dabei geben sie Tipps und Tricks, nennen die spezifischen Schwachstellen einzelner Modelle, verraten die Kniffe der Verkäufer und zeigen, wie man für wenig Geld gute gebrauchte Autos kaufen kann.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping - (Nachrichtenprogramm , Deutschland, 2026) Um einzukaufen, muss man nicht das Haus verlassen. Auch nach Ladenschluss sind mit dieser Sendung Einkäufe ganz bequem vom Sofa aus zu erledigen. Beim Teleshopping werden von den kompetenten Moderatoren innovative und exklusive Produkte aus den verschiedensten Bereichen wie Haushalt, Freizeit, Fitness oder Kosmetik präsentiert und können dann per Telefon oder Internet bestellt werden.

His distinctive guitar picking style and instantly recognisable voice are joined to his dynamic on stage presence to deliver a show that brings the audience to their feet and leaves them calling for more. programme.desc: Kylie 3D - Aphrodite-Les Folies - Live in London - (concert film, England, 2011) Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- Can t Get You Out Of My Head, Spinning Around- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed Aphrodite album including All The Lovers and Get Outta My Way., R.: Kylie Minogue

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: Robbie Williams : Live at the Apple Music Festival - (concert film, England, 2016) A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group Take That, lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: Let me resubmit .... Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist. Already in the 40s band of pop music, Robbie is more than an artist consecrated worldwide, is a reference with hits present in the best lists of consecrated DJs. This show at the Roundhouse coincided with the announcement of their 11th solo album, Heavy Entertainment Show, just released. The new album's title reflects Williams' performance as energy-dense as his 11-member big band, including his hits partner Guy Chambers on the piano. A formidable 90 minute pop odyssey. Mixing tracks from his Take That era, old or new, his songs allow him to reclaim his throne from an artist who dominates the stage - in fact, there is no one in pop music who combines his monumental energy with music Touching. A magical moment can be perceived in A Better Man, only with the guitar on stage; Proof that he is an artist that goes beyond the scenery.

programme.title: 21 gram
programme.desc: Naomi Watts i Benicio Del Toro nominirani su za Oscara za ovu tragičnu priču u kojoj neobična nesreća spaja tri problematične osobe. U glavnoj ulozi je i Sean Penn.

programme.title: Zalomilo se
programme.desc: Kažu da se suprotnosti privlače, što se za Bena i Alison pokazalo točnim, barem za jednu večer.

programme.title: Frka s Dick i Jane
programme.desc: Menadžer srednjeg ranga i njegova supruga žive dobar život sve dok ga izvršni direktor tvrtke ne postavi za javno lice katastrofe. Nezaposleni i bez ušteđevine, par se okreće kriminalu.

programme.title: Pet legendi
programme.desc: Kad zli duh Pitch pokrene napad na Zemlju, Besmrtni Čuvari udružuju se da zaštite nevinost djece diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Vatrene loptice
programme.desc: Agent FBI-a Ernie Rodriguez za tajnu misiju angažira bivšeg profesionalnog majstora stolnog tenisa.

programme.title: Mali vojnici
programme.desc: Govorne tehnološke igračke poboljšane vojnim mikročipovima ubrzo počinju preozbiljno shvaćati svoje borbeno programiranje u ovoj satiričnoj akcijskoj komediji redatelja

programme.title: Priča o Rickyju Bobbyju
programme.desc: NASCAR-ova trkačka senzacija Ricky Bobby na vrhuncu je karijere, no kad francuski vozač Formule 1 počne nizati uspjehe, Rickyjev talent i predanost stavljeni su na kušnju.

programme.title: Pikseli
programme.desc: Kada vanzemaljci pogrešno protumače video zapise klasičnih arkadnih igara kao objavu rata, oni napadnu Zemlju u obliku videoigara.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Pojavljuje se divovsko, reptilsko čudovište koje sve uništava. Da zaustave čudovište, znanstvenik koji proučava gliste, njegova bivša djevojka i drugi neočekivani junaci udružuju se da spase grad.

programme.title: U mraku katakombe
programme.desc: Kad tim istraživača krene u katakombe koje se nalaze ispod pariških ulica, otkrivaju mračnu tajnu koja se krije u ovom gradu mrtvih.

programme.title: Sotona
programme.desc: Zastrašujući horor o skupini ljudi koji se zaglave u liftu, a jedan od tih ljudi je Sotona.

programme.title: Jobs
programme.desc: Priča o usponu Stevea Jobsa od osobe koja je napustila fakultet do jednog od najcjenjenijih kreativnih poduzetnika 20. stoljeća.

programme.title: Chucky postaje tata
programme.desc: Chuckyja i Tiffany povezuje njihova nevina kći Glenda, zbunjena oko svog spola. Oni odlaze u Hollywood gdje je u tijeku snimanje filma koji prikazuje ubilački pohod lutaka ubojica.

programme.title: Sinbad – Legenda o sedam mora
programme.desc: Božica Eris optužuje Sinbada za krađu Knjige mira te mora otputovati u njezino carstvo na kraju svijeta kako bi je vratio i spasio život svog prijatelja iz djetinjstva, princa Proteja.

programme.title: Jack i Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein, uspješan direktor oglašavanja u Los Angelesu, svake se godine boji posjeta svoje sestre blizanke Jill na Dan zahvalnosti.

programme.title: Pikseli
programme.desc: Kada vanzemaljci pogrešno protumače video zapise klasičnih arkadnih igara kao objavu rata, oni napadnu Zemlju u obliku videoigara.

programme.title: Čudovišta protiv vanzemaljaca
programme.desc: Žena pretvorena u diva nakon što je udari meteorit postaje dio tima čudovišta koje je poslala američka vlada da poraze izvanzemaljskog genija koji pokušava preoteti Zemlju.

programme.title: Everest
programme.desc: Temeljeno na istinitoj priči – tragična planinarska ekspedicija na Mt. Everestu je uništena kada planinu pogodi jaka snježna oluja. U glavnoj ulozi je Jake Gyllenhaal.

programme.title: Sedam godina u Tibetu
programme.desc: Heinrich Harrer putuje na Himalaju kako bi planinario. No, izbija rat pa bježi u Tibet gdje se sprijatelji s mladim Dalaj Lamom.

programme.title: Dolazak
programme.desc: Lingvist surađuje s vojskom kako bi komunicirao s izvanzemaljskim oblicima života nakon što se dvanaest misterioznih svemirskih letjelica pojavi u svijetu.

programme.title: Smrtna tišina
programme.desc: Udovac se vraća u rodni grad da pronađe odgovorne za ubojstvo svoje supruge što bi moglo biti povezano s duhom ubijenog trbuhozborca.

programme.title: Veza bez obveza

programme.title: Sotona
